segments.line: What if you could see something about other people that they'd never know you could see?
Alex stands up from the bench.
Above Sam's head — a number. Twelve.
It's my own design. No one else has one.
When I wear it, a small number appears above each person's head.
A dark pill with a colored outline, almost touching the top of their head. It shows how many lives they've already lived.
Reincarnation. Call it what you will.
The numbers vary. Most are single digits. Some are higher.
The number ticks down when a life is spent. Used up. Passed.
What if you could see how many lives everyone has lived?
